sources.statusReason: Listing and article parsers validated on live pages 2026-11-17. Radware Bot Manager challenged most requests after roughly ten from one IP; measure from deployment egress and request allowlisting before activation.

accessPolicy.termsSummary: Content is copyrighted; reproduction only where authorized or under legal exceptions, citing the source clearly; commercial or promotional use requires prior authorization; use that overloads the Bank's systems is prohibited.

sources.statusReason: Live run 2026-11-17 stored 13 of 23 changed records (abstracts, bilingual titles, issued dates, 50 file links) before Radware challenged after ~14 requests; the rest are queued for retry. Bitstream (PDF) downloads are captcha-gated, so only abstracts are stored.

sources.statusReason: Open SDMX 2.1 REST service behind the SUAMECA statistics portal; no credential. Validated live 2026-11-17 (9 requests, no challenge): policy rate, TRM, IBR and UVR parsed. XML only (JSON/CSV answered 406 despite the announced upgrade); endPeriod returns 404, so windows are applied client-side. The host carries the same Radware script as banrep.gov.co.

accessPolicy.termsSummary: The Bank's legal notice covers statistics served through its SDMX service under the same conditions as the website: cite the source; commercial or promotional use requires prior authorization.

sources.statusReason: Every HTML page tested (press listings, press releases, terms, Liferay APIs) returns an Imperva Incapsula JavaScript challenge to non-browser clients; robots.txt also disallows search and */reunion-de-politica-monetaria-rpm* paths. PDFs under /documents/ are served openly, so discovery needs BCCh allowlisting or a live-search provider (bilingual search discovery is implemented, no provider chosen).

accessPolicy.termsSummary: Material may be reviewed, downloaded, printed, or copied without alteration for personal or organizational use with proper citation; sale or distribution requires prior express authorization; third-party material needs its owner's consent.

sources.statusReason: Requires a BDE account with the API enabled and an API Key Token (env BCCH_BDE_TOKEN). Client built against the documented payload; not yet validated live.

accessPolicy.termsSummary: Free, indefinite, revocable right to use BDE data; at most 5 series requests per second per enabled account; repeated breaches may suspend access.

sources.statusReason: Open SDMX files behind BCCh's IMF National Summary Data Page; no credential. Validated live 2026-11-17 (10 categories, no challenge): CPI, exchange rate, interest rate, reserves, trade, production, national accounts, balance of payments, government operations and debt. Monthly/quarterly headline series since 2010; daily detail still needs the token-gated BDE API.

accessPolicy.termsSummary: BCCh terms allow unaltered use with citation; its statistics terms allow free consultation, reproduction, publication and adaptation citing the Bank or the original source. Some categories are compiled by INE or DIPRES and are cited to them.

sources.statusReason: OAI-PMH answers machines (the web UI does not), but holdings are historical (policy meeting minutes 1997–2014, statistical yearbooks) and every record is re-stamped nightly, so incremental harvests return the whole repository (8,269 records on 2026-11-17). Kept for background backfill only.
